results.title: Ring Ring...
results.overview: A seemingly normal meeting between a man named John Smith and a lawyer named C.C. Baxter takes an unexpected turn.

results.title: Retrovisor
results.overview: As dusk falls over Recife, hidden threats take an escape route from hellish traffic.

results.title: Fault Lines
results.overview: For Noah Lane, the ocean has always been a place of freedom. But when a near-fatal accident at infamous Irish big wave spot Mullaghmore brings him face to face with his own mortality, the life he has built around the water begins to take on a different meaning.

results.title: User Not Found
results.overview: During his live selling, Sebbie receives an unexpected comment from a mysterious stranger. As the messages grow more personal, he is drawn into an unsettling encounter that stirs something long buried within him and leaving him with one haunting question... who is on the other side of the screen, and why does it feel like he has been waiting for them all his life?

results.title: inseperable Gaze
results.overview: Two lovers seeing each other naked for the first time.

results.title: Nathan
results.overview: When an ordinary situation takes an unexpectedly dramatic turn, one name becomes the centre of everything: Nathan. This cinematic comedy transforms a simple internet joke into an unnecessarily intense motion picture, complete with dramatic storytelling, questionable decisions, and absolutely zero explanation.

results.title: Too Much Light Makes the Baby Go Blind
results.original_title: Too Much Light Makes the Baby Go Blind
results.overview: The NHS Production of Too Much Light Makes the Baby Go Blind is an ensemble-driven, high-octane theatrical experience where the cast attempts to perform 30 short 1-2 minute plays in a strict 60-minute timeframe. Maintained by an onstage digital clock, the performance functions as a living experiment where actors play themselves in the immediate present. There are no traditional characters, no times where the ensemble is off stage, and no fourth wall.

results.title: Wrapped in Wool
results.overview: On a cold snowy winter day, Bernadette, a sweet lonely older woman sits alone in her warm but quiet house. Surrounded by empty sofas, wool and knitting needles, she feels useless and longs for someone to knit for, to look after and to love. Until a frozen puppy suddenly appears at her front door.

results.title: God Bless, My Child
results.overview: When Thai immigrant Mali’s mother secretly converts from Buddhism to Christianity, she is left searching for what still remains between them; across culture, distance, and faith.

results.title: Dilwali Diwali
results.overview: Ansh Sikkha returns to his Punjabi family home for Diwali after years working abroad. As the Sikkas gather for the festival, their clashing views on what constitutes a fulfilling life create friction and connection.

results.title: in the heart there is a stone
results.original_title: in the heart there is a stone
results.overview: Naomi calls Matteo and compares him to the sea: how can you ask the waves to be anything other than waves? To have known him is enough. His answer is less enthusiastic, and finding herself emptier than she had thought, she heads into a rocky valley to find inner connection: to hear what the rocks, trees, and wind have to say about it all.

results.title: Behind The Passion
results.overview: Qatar 2022 was the most expensive World Cup in history. Behind the spectacle sat a system built on bribery and forced labor, one that consumed the men who built it, and a governing body with every reason not to look. In Rosario, Argentina, a human rights organization shaped by the horrors of its own country's past set out to make sure someone did.

results.title: Where There are Nilad Flowers
results.original_title: Kung Saan Nagbunga ang mga Nilad
results.overview: While walking the streets of Manila, a student filmmaker reflects on the phenomenon of change and time as they document the city's various heritage sites.

results.title: Hidden Colors 6: The Culture of Resistance
results.original_title: Hidden Colors 6: The Culture of Resistance
results.overview: Hidden Colors 6 examines overlooked stories of Black American resistance, resilience, innovation and cultural survival.
